profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Lead Software Engineer with extensive experience in object-oriented programming and embedded systems design and development. Proficient in multiple programming languages and embedded architectures, with practical expertise across every phase of the software development lifecycle. Well-versed in Agile methodologies and experienced in supporting government software assessments, compliance, and certification initiatives.
